items.explanation: The present perfect is haber + participle: has estado.
optionNotes: The helper verb is haber, not tener.
Eres is ser in the present.

items.explanation: Hacer has an irregular participle: hecho.
optionNotes: Hacer does not take -ido: the participle is hecho.
After haber comes the participle, not the infinitive.

items.explanation: Nunca goes before haber. After the verb you need no: No he estado nunca en Chile.
optionNotes: Nothing goes between haber and the participle.
Nunca after the verb needs no before it: No he estado nunca.

items.explanation: Ayer is a finished time, so it takes the preterite everywhere.
optionNotes: Ayer is a finished time: preterite, not the present perfect.
After haber comes the participle: hablado.
